title: A catalog of saved hearing memos, testimony and bills, from late 2024 to mid-2026
adds: Katie's vault keeps a wide shelf of congressional hearing documents beyond the House Oversight set. The study keeps each source type's limits attached: a committee memo, prepared testimony and a bill text are different kinds of evidence, not transcripts of what was said.
contribution_scope: Reviewed navigation description; read each source for its own claim and clock.
navigation_contribution: Find prepared testimony, hearing memoranda, bills and other congressional records while distinguishing written submissions from delivered testimony and formal transcripts.
summary_role: Exact saved study bottom line; object-local evidence date retained.
